summary_1line: Dhritarashtra mourns the presumed deaths of the Pandavas while they secretly flee into the forest, where Bhima carries and protects his exhausted family.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima strides through the dark forest carrying Kunti and his brothers as trees bend and break against his powerful chest.
In the palace, Dhritarashtra and the Kuru court pour water oblations and cry out the names of the supposedly dead Pandavas.
Under a wide banyan tree at night, the exhausted Pandavas and Kunti sleep on bare earth while Bhima returns with water-soaked cloths.
